## Import raw SINAN files

The primary study period is 2016-2025. The 2026 file is kept separate for held-out temporal validation and is never included in the primary analytic dataset.

```{r import}
CHIK16 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR16.dbc"))
CHIK17 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR17.dbc"))
CHIK18 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR18.dbc"))
CHIK19 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR19.dbc"))
CHIK20 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR20.dbc"))
CHIK21 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR21.dbc"))
CHIK22 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR22.dbc"))
CHIK23 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR23.dbc"))
CHIK24 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR24.dbc"))
CHIK25 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR25.dbc"))

# Held-out 2026 data; never bind into Chik_total.
CHIK26 <- read.dbc(file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR26.dbc"))
```

## Construct the 2016-2025 analytic dataset

```{r combine}
chik_list <- list(
  CHIK16, CHIK17, CHIK18, CHIK19, CHIK20,
  CHIK21, CHIK22, CHIK23, CHIK24, CHIK25
)

Chik_notifications <- bind_rows(chik_list) %>%
  mutate(DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI))

Chik_2026 <- CHIK26 %>%
  mutate(DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI))

# Final primary case definition used throughout the revised pipeline.
Chik_total <- Chik_notifications %>%
  filter(
    CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13),
    !is.na(DT_SIN_PRI),
    DT_SIN_PRI >= as.Date("2016-01-01"),
    DT_SIN_PRI <= as.Date("2025-12-31")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_all   = as.integer(format(DT_SIN_PRI, "%Y")),
    year       = format(DT_SIN_PRI, "%Y"),
    month      = format(DT_SIN_PRI, "%m"),
    year_month = format(DT_SIN_PRI, "%Y-%m")
  )

stopifnot(
  all(Chik_total$year_all >= 2016 & Chik_total$year_all <= 2025),
  all(Chik_total$CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13))
)

# Useful audit table retained in the rendered notebook.
chik_cases_by_year <- Chik_total %>%
  count(year_all, name = "cases")

chik_cases_by_year
```

## Decode age and derive analysis variables

`NU_IDADE_N` uses a four-digit coding scheme in which the first digit identifies the unit: 1 = hour, 2 = day, 3 = month, and 4 = year.

```{r derived-variables}
decode_age_years <- function(NU_IDADE_N) {
  unit_code <- floor(NU_IDADE_N / 1000)
  value <- NU_IDADE_N %% 1000

  dplyr::case_when(
    unit_code == 1 ~ value / (24 * 365),
    unit_code == 2 ~ value / 365,
    unit_code == 3 ~ value / 12,
    unit_code == 4 ~ value,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

age_levels <- c(
  "< 1", "1-4", "5-9", "10-14", "15-19", "20-24", "25-29",
  "30-34", "35-39", "40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59",
  "60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "85-89",
  "90-94", "95-99", "100+"
)

Chik_total <- Chik_total %>%
  mutate(
    case_status = if_else(EVOLUCAO == 2, "Death", "Confirmed", missing = "Confirmed"),
    age_years = decode_age_years(NU_IDADE_N),
    virus = "Chikungunya",
    age_group = case_when(
      age_years >= 0   & age_years < 1   ~ "< 1",
      age_years >= 1   & age_years < 5   ~ "1-4",
      age_years >= 5   & age_years < 10  ~ "5-9",
      age_years >= 10  & age_years < 15  ~ "10-14",
      age_years >= 15  & age_years < 20  ~ "15-19",
      age_years >= 20  & age_years < 25  ~ "20-24",
      age_years >= 25  & age_years < 30  ~ "25-29",
      age_years >= 30  & age_years < 35  ~ "30-34",
      age_years >= 35  & age_years < 40  ~ "35-39",
      age_years >= 40  & age_years < 45  ~ "40-44",
      age_years >= 45  & age_years < 50  ~ "45-49",
      age_years >= 50  & age_years < 55  ~ "50-54",
      age_years >= 55  & age_years < 60  ~ "55-59",
      age_years >= 60  & age_years < 65  ~ "60-64",
      age_years >= 65  & age_years < 70  ~ "65-69",
      age_years >= 70  & age_years < 75  ~ "70-74",
      age_years >= 75  & age_years < 80  ~ "75-79",
      age_years >= 80  & age_years < 85  ~ "80-84",
      age_years >= 85  & age_years < 90  ~ "85-89",
      age_years >= 90  & age_years < 95  ~ "90-94",
      age_years >= 95  & age_years < 100 ~ "95-99",
      age_years >= 100 & age_years <= 120 ~ "100+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = age_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    race_label = case_when(
      CS_RACA == 1 ~ "White",
      CS_RACA == 2 ~ "Black",
      CS_RACA == 3 ~ "Asian",
      CS_RACA == 4 ~ "Pardo (Mixed)",
      CS_RACA == 5 ~ "Indigenous",
      CS_RACA == 9 ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ "Unspecified"
    ),
    age_group_surv10 = case_when(
      !is.na(age_years) & age_years < 1  ~ "<1",
      age_years >= 1  & age_years < 10   ~ "1-9",
      age_years >= 10 & age_years < 20   ~ "10-19",
      age_years >= 20 & age_years < 30   ~ "20-29",
      age_years >= 30 & age_years < 40   ~ "30-39",
      age_years >= 40 & age_years < 50   ~ "40-49",
      age_years >= 50 & age_years < 60   ~ "50-59",
      age_years >= 60 & age_years < 70   ~ "60-69",
      age_years >= 70 & age_years < 80   ~ "70-79",
      age_years >= 80 & age_years <= 120 ~ ">=80",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    age_group_surv10 = factor(
      age_group_surv10,
      levels = c(
        "<1", "1-9", "10-19", "20-29", "30-39",
        "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", ">=80"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

# Legacy object name retained because downstream scripts still use it.
combined_all <- Chik_total
```

## Analytic population checks

```{r sanity-checks}
total_notifications <- nrow(Chik_notifications)
missing_date <- sum(is.na(Chik_notifications$DT_SIN_PRI))

out_of_range <- Chik_notifications %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(DT_SIN_PRI),
    DT_SIN_PRI < as.Date("2016-01-01") |
      DT_SIN_PRI > as.Date("2025-12-31")
  ) %>%
  nrow()

eligible_date_notifications <- Chik_notifications %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(DT_SIN_PRI),
    DT_SIN_PRI >= as.Date("2016-01-01"),
    DT_SIN_PRI <= as.Date("2025-12-31")
  )

not_confirmed <- eligible_date_notifications %>%
  filter(!(CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13))) %>%
  nrow()

final_n <- nrow(Chik_total)
reconciled_n <- total_notifications - missing_date - out_of_range - not_confirmed

# Use decoded age rather than the raw field so invalid age codes are also detected.
n_missing_or_invalid_age <- sum(is.na(Chik_total$age_years))
n_missing_or_invalid_sex <- sum(is.na(Chik_total$CS_SEXO) | !(Chik_total$CS_SEXO %in% c("M", "F")))

analytic_population_check <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "Raw notifications, 2016-2025 source files",
    "Missing notification date",
    "Notification date outside study period",
    "Not confirmed by CLASSI_FIN definition",
    "Final confirmed analytic sample",
    "Missing/invalid decoded age",
    "Missing/invalid sex"
  ),
  n = c(
    total_notifications,
    missing_date,
    out_of_range,
    not_confirmed,
    final_n,
    n_missing_or_invalid_age,
    n_missing_or_invalid_sex
  )
)

analytic_population_check

stopifnot(
  reconciled_n == final_n,
  nrow(combined_all) == nrow(Chik_total),
  identical(combined_all, Chik_total)
)
```

## Save the analytic object for downstream sessions

```{r save-analytic-object}
saveRDS(Chik_total, result_path("Chik_total.rds"))
```
